北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今日体感 0℃，晴朗干燥，记得多喝水，注意保暖防风哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like 0℃. Sunny and dry, stay hydrated and keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 11℃，虽暖但早晚温差大，别忘了添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels 11℃. Warm but mind the temperature swings, remember to layer up!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 9℃。阴天微凉，记得带件外套，别着凉哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels 9℃. Cloudy and a bit chilly, bring a jacket to stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，体感 21℃。舒适好天气，别忘了防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels 21℃. Lovely weather, remember your sunscreen!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，体感 18℃。湿度适中，记得多补充水分哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, feels 18℃. Stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 7℃。有点凉意，出门多穿点，注意保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels 7℃. A bit chilly, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 9℃。微风稍凉，记得添衣，别感冒哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels 9℃. A bit chilly, remember to layer up!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴好，体感 12℃。湿度适宜，多喝水，享受美好天气！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels 12℃. Comfortable humidity, stay hydrated!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 12℃。风力 4级，出门注意防风保暖哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels 12℃. With level 4 winds, remember wind protection!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 11℃。湿度很低，多喝水、润肤保湿哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels 11℃. Very low humidity, stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 13℃。出行记得戴口罩，注意呼吸防护！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hazy, feels 13℃. Remember to wear a mask for protection!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大雾，体感 -20℃！极寒，务必全副武装，注意安全！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy, feels -20℃! Extremely cold, bundle up completely, stay safe!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -9℃。风力 4级，出门一定要穿暖，防感冒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cold, feels -9℃. With level 4 winds, dress warmly!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 11℃。气候宜人，早晚微凉，记得添外套！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels 11℃. Pleasant, but bring a jacket for mornings/evenings!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 15℃。阳光正好，出门防晒，享受美好时光！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and feels 15℃. Perfect for sun, remember sunscreen!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 3℃。有风微凉，记得多穿点，别冻着！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny and feels 3℃. Chilly with wind, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -3℃。风力 4级，户外务必做好防风保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels -3℃. With level 4 winds, ensure wind protection outdoors!
